lines.t: Yeah, banners up, boots on
This is for the throne, never flinched
Hit with a snarling palm, muted riff, time's rolling like armor rolling in
Crown don't slip when he walks through fire
Every dark king bow to the higher
Steel in his eyes, thunder in his hand
He owns the sky, he owns the land
Raise that flag, let the whole world see
There's only one boss of eternity
All black thrones and the snakes they bred
Fall like dust when he lifts his head
Boots on the ground with the flame in his vein
War in his step and a smile in the rain
Every back room packed, every coat and ring
Come undone when the real king swings
No ghost in the wise, no hidden court
Can stand up straight when he cuts that cord
He flips man's chaos on the man who planned it
Drops that gavel and the whole earth slams
But he the storm in the desert, he the calm in the blast
He the first roar coming and the last one to laugh
He don't need your vote or your praise on cue
He gave the breath you cuss him with, too
You wanted crowns, he melts them down
Forge them into chains, then he breaks them on the ground
This is royal blood, not a borrowed throne
Every rival got just skin and bones
The crown don't slip when it walks through fire
Every dark king bowed to the higher
Steel in his eyes, thunder in his head
He owns the sky, he owns the land
Raise that flag, let the whole world see
There's only one boss of eternity
All black thrones and the snakes they bred
Fall like dust when he lifts his head
He ride that line between wrath and grace
Either lift you up or erase your face
He bring holy chaos just to split your heart
Let the poison rise, tear the lies apart
You get two roads when the drums go still
Kneel in the light or get broke on his will
Either washed in fire till you shine like steel
Or left with the night when the trumpets peal
Spirits in the shadows try to crowd his stage
He turns their roar into a rusty cage
Every curse they throw gets turned around
round hits him in the chest when he shakes that ground he don't share rooms with pretend the kings
he kicks in doors and he rips out strings from the pit to the palace is one verdict fall
victor on high and he owns it all
when the lion takes it back
Oh, let the war drum sing
Every man choose for a piece
Gang shouts under it
One king
Non-king, no ties
All dark falls when he rises
All your empires
All your ghosts
All your deals in the dark
One blaze from his face
And it's over
I've missed it all
